etaAudit.ruleChecked: Qualify 3x divergence claim and define required 4-stage validation pipeline.
etaAudit.statementAudited: At least one reviewer reported an approximately 3x discrepancy versus Google Maps; this requires validation against actual predicted-versus-arrival data.
validationPipeline: Stage 1: Predicted ETA capture at trip assignment and dynamic intervals
Stage 2: Actual cab arrival timestamp recorded at pickup geo-fence
Stage 3: Route conditions and multi-passenger boarding dwell time analysis
Stage 4: Comparison against an appropriate reference baseline (Google Maps is not automatically treated as ground truth)
